title: 订单模块 · 补齐折扣与参数校验
requirements: Keep existing subtotal(prices) behavior and code unchanged. Complete discounted_total(prices, rate): return subtotal(prices) * (1 - rate), allowing rate from 0 to 1 inclusive. Invalid rates (<0 or >1) must raise ValueError. Empty prices returns 0.0 for a valid rate. Preserve both public function signatures.
